citationText: Taking the average directivity of a loudspeaker and the head into account, plus the average reverberation time of a listening room, the home listener sits for lower frequencies (<~3 kHz) outside and for higher frequencies inside the critical distance, the border between the direct field and reverberant field. Personal communication, A. Silzle, 2014.
